name: AGENT IA Business Analyst — Phase 2 — FOLIO APP

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  m.id as mission_id,
  m.nom_mission,
  m.client_id,
  c.nom as client_nom,
  c.site_web,
  c.secteur,
  c.localisation,
  c.data as client_data
FROM agent_business_analyst.missions m
JOIN agent_business_analyst.clients c ON c.id = m.client_id
WHERE m.id = '{{ $('Extract body').item.json.mission_id }}'::uuid;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO agent_business_analyst.resultats_phases (
  id, mission_id, phase, titre, statut
) VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(),
  '{{ $('Prepare Context P2').item.json.mission_id }}'::uuid,
  2,
  'Etude sectorielle',
  'running'
)
ON CONFLICT (mission_id, phase) DO UPDATE SET
  statut = 'running',
  updated_at = now();

UPDATE agent_business_analyst.resultats_phases 
SET 
  statut = 'completed',
  contenu_json = '{{ $('Parse analyse sectorielle').item.json.analyse_json_string }}'::jsonb,
  tokens_input = {{ $('Parse analyse sectorielle').item.json.tokens_input }},
  tokens_output = {{ $('Parse analyse sectorielle').item.json.tokens_output }},
  completed_at = now()
WHERE mission_id = '{{ $('Parse analyse sectorielle').item.json.mission_id }}'::uuid
  AND phase = 2;
